title: Website visit settings
description: Send labeled HTTP visits to public endpoints you own or have permission to test.

startUrls.title: Website URLs
startUrls.description: One to ten public HTTP or HTTPS URLs without credentials, query strings or custom ports.

visitCount.title: Total visits
visitCount.description: Number of visits. Allow at least one for each supplied URL.

concurrency.title: Simultaneous visits
concurrency.description: Maximum visits in progress at once.

intervalMs.title: Request spacing (ms)
intervalMs.description: Minimum gap between HTTP request starts.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per visit (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Maximum visit duration including DNS and redirects.

requestLabels.title: Request labels
requestLabels.description: Rotate between desktop, mobile and tablet labels in your server logs.

discoverLinks.title: Discover site links
discoverLinks.description: Use remaining visits on same-origin links allowed by robots.txt.
